basic_details.job_title: Government ITI Pudukkottai Office Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The Government Industrial Training Institute, Pudukkottai (அரசினர் தொழிற்பயிற்சி நிலையம் புதுக்கோட்டை), under the Department of Employment and Training, Government of Tamil Nadu, is taking applications for 2 Office Assistant (அலுவலக உதவியாளர்) vacancies. One vacancy is in the General Turn and one is in the SC (A) women (Destitute widow) priority turn. Applications go to the Principal of the institute in Pudukkottai, by post or in person, and must reach by 5.45 PM on 17 November 2026. The institute will reject applications that arrive late.

content_sections.heading: About ITI Pudukkottai
content_sections.text: The Government Industrial Training Institute, Pudukkottai, is a Government of Tamil Nadu institute under the Department of Employment and Training. It is on Tiruchi Main Road, Thirugokarnam, Pudukkottai. The District Collector signed this recruitment notice.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates send their application with self-attested copies of the relevant certificates. They can send it by post, or hand it in at the office on office working days. The address is: Principal, Government Industrial Training Institute, Tiruchi Main Road, Thirugokarnam Post, Pudukkottai, 622 002 (முதல்வர், அரசினர் தொழிற் பயிற்சி நிலையம், திருச்சி மெயின்ரோடு, திருக்கோகர்ணம் அஞ்சல், புதுக்கோட்டை, 622 002) Check that you meet the qualification and the age limit for your category. Self-attest copies of the relevant certificates. Send the application with the certificate copies to the Principal at the address above by post, or hand it in at the office on an office working day. Make sure the application reaches the office by 5.45 PM on 17 November 2026. The institute will reject applications from ineligible candidates, applications that arrive late and applications that are not fully filled in. faq.question: Q1. How many Office Assistant vacancies are there at ITI Pudukkottai?
faq.answer: There are 2 Office Assistant vacancies at the Government Industrial Training Institute, Pudukkottai. One is in the General Turn Priority and one is in the SC (A) women Priority (Destitute widow).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the ITI Pudukkottai Office Assistant post?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the Principal, Government Industrial Training Institute, Pudukkottai, by 5.45 PM on 17 November 2026. Applications that arrive late will be rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification do I need for the ITI Pudukkottai Office Assistant post?
faq.answer: You need an 8th standard pass. You must also be able to read and write Tamil fluently and know how to ride a bicycle.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the ITI Pudukkottai Office Assistant post?
faq.answer: The age limit is 35 for SC (A) / SC / ST, 32 for MBC / BC and 30 for OC candidates. All candidates must have completed 18 years of age on 30 September 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What age relaxation does the notice allow?
faq.answer: Differently abled candidates get an additional 10 years, and ex-servicemen get additional years as per the rules. Destitute widows get an additional 5 years, plus the relaxation for their own community.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of an ITI Pudukkottai Office Assistant?
faq.answer: The pay for the Office Assistant post is 15700-58100 (Level 1).

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the ITI Pudukkottai Office Assistant post?
faq.answer: Send your application with self-attested copies of the relevant certificates to: Principal, Government Industrial Training Institute, Tiruchi Main Road, Thirugokarnam Post, Pudukkottai, 622 002. You can send it by post or hand it in at the office on an office working day.

faq.question: Q8. Which ITI Pudukkottai Office Assistant vacancy is reserved for destitute widows?
faq.answer: Vacancy No. 2 is in the SC (A) women Priority (Destitute widow) turn. Vacancy No. 1 is in the General Turn Priority.

faq.question: Q9. Which applications will be rejected?
faq.answer: The institute will reject applications from ineligible candidates, applications that arrive late and applications that are not fully filled in.
